label: With POTENCY_1 (adopted), nothing moves itself in the same respect
description: POTENCY_1 (ADOPTED) branch of the prima via step: what is moved in a respect is not in act in it (adopted potency), and what moves in a respect is in act in it; so nothing moves itself in the respect in which it is moved. No non-simultaneity premise is needed: the ADOPTED definition contains it. The controls show each of the two premises is needed.
